title: Health insurers, TPAs and public health-coverage schemes in Jordan
publisher: Central Bank of Jordan (insurance supervisor); MoH Health Insurance Administration; others as cited per record
notes: 19 licensed insurers (CBJ list; it does not flag the medical line, so medical activity is only confirmed where the CBJ 2025 medical-statistics market-share chart names the company or the site shows a medical network) + 8 licensed TPAs (CBJ, licensed to 2026-12-31) + 6 public/other schemes. The Jordan Insurance Federation site (joif.org) did not respond, so its member list was not used. name_en is only filled where a source shows it (TPA brand names in the CBJ list; insurer names from the company's own site title); otherwise null. Arabia Insurance - Jordan merged into Jerusalem Insurance (completed 2026-08-09 per jico.jo) but is still on the CBJ list. CBJ 2025 medical stats: ~89% of medical premiums are group policies; ~305k people covered by TPA-managed self-funded schemes. Network URLs collected from each homepage's links only (pages not crawled). Raw: sources/raw/insurers_jo/.
